bootstrap.unit: case (paired: every cell and system of a resampled case comes along)

field_notes.omission_degeneracy: residue.<pooled|by_system>.omission_degeneracy: notes where the frozen verbatim omission comparator is 1.0, and the exceptions with case, system and value. Descriptive only.
field_notes.provenance: protocol number, protocol file and its commit, source runs, and sha256 of the input files.
field_notes.rate: alias of rate_all, kept so readers written before the explicit keys keep working.
field_notes.rate_all: harmful_flip, wrong_commit, abstention, parse_error: count / n_all, n_all = every case of the cell.
field_notes.rate_gated: the same count / n_gated, n_gated = cases of the cell with a_H == a_star.
field_notes.recoverability: residue.<pooled|by_system>.recoverability: how the flip searches of the residue flips ended. The four counts sum to n_residue_flips. The not_recoverable_diagnostic is descriptive only.
field_notes.recoverability.restored: restored_1_minimal + restored_cap_hit; its share is restored.share. shares.restored_1_minimal is the 1-minimal part only. Do not confuse the two.

rag-bm25.h2b_verdict: descriptive (residue flips 9 below the minimum 20; bounds only, no claim)

rag-embed.h2b_verdict: descriptive (residue flips 1 below the minimum 20; bounds only, no claim)

recent.h2b_verdict: descriptive (residue flips 0 below the minimum 20; bounds only, no claim)

residue.definition: eligible: a_H == a_star and a_A = a_V == a_H at the residue budget; residue_rate = P(a_B != target), floor_rate = P(v2 decision on V != a_A), trunc_rate = P(B on the last 150 tokens of V != target); H2b on event-view systems with every D* event in V and a restored search; H2c AUROC of p_residue for residue flips

pooled.h2b_verdict: descriptive (residue flips 10 below the minimum 20; bounds only, no claim)
